name: Rayglass Vault
description: Probe an opaque optical cabinet and reconstruct hidden bead geometry from reflected, absorbed and exiting rays.
natural_language: Probe numbered border ports to reveal beam responses. Mark the hidden beads, then seal the vault. H means absorbed; R means reflected back; a numbered exit pairs two ports. Beams turn away from a diagonally adjacent bead, with a direct hit taking priority. Any arrangement with the required bead count and identical behavior at every border port is accepted. Queries are counted for efficiency, with no query limit. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to unrelated, pre-existing, blank or browser-settings tabs. Only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task may be used, through their visible controls.

metadata.notes: Original source-grounded ray-probing cabinet. Script evidence is not human or agent calibration.
